title: Concept: WebView loads a computed URL in kotlin — review required
description: In kotlin, a WebView is told to load a URL that is computed at runtime. WebView is not a sandbox boundary: the loaded origin can call any addJavascriptInterface bridge the app registered and can render convincing phishing UI inside the app. Deep links and intent extras are the usual sources, and they are attacker-supplied by definition once the activity is exported.
applicability: kotlin Android apps that render remote content in a WebView.
risk: Navigation to attacker content with bridge exposure; MEDIUM severity.
